messages:
Ana Lopez: opened PR to harmonize audit webhook examples and retention language. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899
Priya Shah: thanks Ana. quick summary of changes? trying to triage for SOC2 wording pass.
Ana Lopez: short summary: rename audit_event_id -> event_id, remove PII from examples, add pseudonymization pattern, provide a curl export example with redaction flags, and add deprecation guidance for legacy keys.
Elena Kaur: paste the new minimal payload example so I can check it for accidental PII:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt-0a1b2c",
  "tenant_id": "t-77aa",
  "occurred_at": "2026-03-15T14:22:00Z",
  "actor": {"kind":"user","pid":"pid-9x9x"},
  "meta": {"pseudonym":"usr-zzzz","ip":"[redacted]"}
}
```
Note: pseudonym only, ip redacted in sample.
Samir Patel: SDK updates: JS and Python parsing examples updated in PR. Also included a tiny compatibility wrapper: `const eventId = payload.event_id || payload.audit_event_id;` and guidance to send X-Deprecation-Warning for legacy key use.
Legal - Compliance: retention phrasing suggestion: "Default retention for audit records is 90 days (configurable by contract). Legal holds will preserve records beyond TTL until released." Also request linking to the evidence playbook and instructions for export and legal-hold requests. Avoid words like "forever" or "permanent".
Ana Lopez: added that exact sentence and a short FAQ entry: "What if my integration submits PII? -> Do not include raw emails/phones. Use pseudonym ids or contact support for a migration plan."
Priya Shah: can we include a curl example that demonstrates redaction at export time? SOC2 folks liked explicit examples.
Elena Kaur: proposed curl snippet in PR:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-01-01","redact_keys":["email","phone","ip"],"format":"jsonl"}' \
  -o audit-export.json
```
Docs will show sample output lines with "ip":"[redacted]".
Devex Bot: linkcheck: evidence playbook link referenced as /evidence-playbook-v2 returns 404 on staging.
Ana Lopez: will fix link target and push an amend. Also adding a short deprecation timeline: keep audit_event_id accepted for 60 days and emit deprecation warning header.
Samir Patel: suggest adding a tiny migration helper in Ruby and Go too; added JS/Python already.
Legal - Compliance: approve wording once the evidence-playbook link is corrected and the export sample demonstrates redaction flags.
Ana Lopez: will push updates in ~25m and tag @Legal - Compliance and @Samir for final read. Thanks :)
Devex Bot: Reminder: after merge run `npm run linkcheck` and add PR # to the release notes.
